question: for Gaya and Nalanda how many percentage points ANC coverage changed from 2021 to 2023
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: WITH base AS (SELECT district, year, pregnancies_registered, anc4_completed, NULLIF(anc4_completed, 0) AS anc4_completed_adj FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)), rates AS (SELECT district, year, (anc4_completed_adj * 100.0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) AS coverage_pct FROM base) SELECT r2023.district, (r2023.coverage_pct - r2021.coverage_pct) AS coverage_change_pct FROM rates AS r2023 JOIN rates AS r2021 ON r2023.district = r2021.district WHERE r2023.year = 2023 AND r2021.year = 2021

attempts.response:
WITH
  base AS (
    SELECT
      district,
      year,
      pregnancies_registered,
      anc4_completed,
      NULLIF(anc4_completed, 0) AS anc4_completed_adj
    FROM anc_visits
    WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
      AND year IN (2021, 2023)
  ),
  rates AS (
    SELECT
      district,
      year,
      (anc4_completed_adj * 100.0) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS coverage_pct
    FROM base
  )
SELECT
  r2023.district,
  (r2023.coverage_pct - r2021.coverage_pct) AS coverage_change_pct
FROM rates r2023
JOIN rates r2021
  ON r2023.district = r2021.district
WHERE r2023.year = 2023
  AND r2021.year = 2021;
